name: request-cover
title: Request response cover sheet
for_each: select id,subject from inquiries where kind='medical'

sections.title: Request record
sections.note: Internal administrative record. No clinical content or regulatory submission.
sections.sql: select replace(k,'_',' ') as field,v as value from inquiry_desk i cross join lateral jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(i)-'id') as f(k,v) where i.id=$1 order by k

sections.title: Review evidence
sections.sql: select response_ref,decision,reviewer,evidence from reviews where inquiry_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Controlled source references
sections.sql: select s.title,s.version,s.reference,s.valid_until,s.withdrawn from reviews r join sources s on s.id=r.source_id where r.inquiry_id=$1

sections.title: Record events
sections.sql: select action,actor,reference,created_at from events where inquiry_id=$1 order by created_at,id
